A React ref prop. The part exposes `validate()`, and the case "validates the field when the `validate` method is called" tests it. `pnpm parity:check` cannot read that member, because vue-component-meta leaves out an exposed member that has the name of a prop, and `validate` is also a prop.

The row gives the default `'onSubmit'`. The part has no Vue default: a prop that is absent takes the `validationMode` of the form, and `'onSubmit'` with no form, as in Base UI. With a Vue default, the part cannot find out that the prop is absent.
